name: Overhaul
text: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on *only open PRs* but log the merged PRs’ autofeedback to a separate, low-priority channel—this cuts resource use while still capturing merged-edge cases. Pair this with a weekly 5-minute review of the low-priority logs to catch critical misses without training reviewers to ignore all feedback.

name: Sprocket
text: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on *all* PRs—open and merged—for two weeks. This gives us full visibility into how PR-Agent behaves across the entire lifecycle, catching edge cases that only appear after merging. The trade-off is higher resource usage, but the data is worth it to avoid surprises later.

name: Ratchet
text:
DECISION: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on high-risk PRs for one week, then review logs and measure signal-to-noise ratio to refine the approach. 
The result must deliver a clear understanding of PR-Agent's effectiveness on critical changes, and Gauge owns the implementation and measurement of this approach.
